svg.title: 历史条件搜索与SGLA共享质量选择
svg.desc: Concise panels a and b for the Stage-113 generated/shared architecture. Real photographic crops from the attributed VisDrone example illustrate history, search crops, template and candidates; all boxes and repeated crops are schematic and are not ground truth, consecutive frames, or experimental predictions. The standard proposal is retained. SGLA uses six prefix blocks and one selected block among L7-L12. The offline Stage-120 commit study is not drawn.
